# 1.2.58 - no welcome window, no second tab

The second stage on the way to 1.3.0: two small things every player met every
session. Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

## Fixed

- **The handbook's contents list no longer opens a second copy of the game.**
  Clicking a section in the list on the left of the handbook window opened the
  game again in a new browser tab. It now only scrolls to that section, by
  mouse or with Enter.

## New

- **Isometric Perspective's welcome window stays closed for everyone.** It is
  a setting of each browser, so switching it off for yourself did nothing for
  the players, who saw it on every start. The module now keeps it off on every
  client and takes its checkbox out of everyone's settings (the GM's too), so
  it cannot be switched back on by accident. A GM can turn this off in the
  module's settings: "Keep Isometric Perspective's welcome window closed for
  everyone". Turned off, the checkbox comes back and each browser can switch
  the window on again.
  It is written so that more such settings can be held the same way; the
  LiveKit ones come in a later stage.

## Checked

- The headless suite and the eleven scenarios; a new scenario asks two
  players' browsers, after a normal start, whether the welcome is held off and
  its box hidden, and fails with the feature switched off. Two scenario checks
  still fail on the two known leaks scheduled for later stages (1.2.57 notes).
- Checked headless that the value is already held when Isometric
  Perspective reads it in its own `ready` (the harness stands in for that
  module), and that a box which cannot be hidden still has its value held.
- Not checked at a real table yet: one GM and two players with fresh
  browsers, first start and a second start; the real Configure Settings row
  gone for a player; and the handbook's contents list clicked in Foundry.
